conservative_name_search_rule: Search by task verbs, mechanism terms, abbreviations, synonyms; verify actual SKILL.md semantics. Missing name tokens are not evidence of missing capability. statuses: Unknown in this index; read per-ID verification and provenance companions. An existing record may be verified, rejected, candidate-only, not-run or reference-only. A review record is not approved for install.
